text:
Zoe: Quick mock: legend rows show name + muted unit badge + 3-bin mini-sparkline. Hover expands to show p50/p95 and a small 'convert' pill (e.g., rps 7 req/s) so folks can flip units inline. Screenshot: <link>
Hiro: Love the convert pill. Make it keyboard-focusable and announceable: 'convert units button'. a11y: role=button and aria-pressed state.
Cam: Outlier handling: default to 'fade' for points beyond 99th percentile and expose a chevron control to expand the scale. Tooltip: 'Value beyond 99p  click to include'.
Zoe: Smoothing: OFF by default for dashboards. Add a non-blocking banner: 'Smoothing available (preview)'. Toggle opens narrow modal to pick window size with instant preview.
Hiro: Copy tweak: legend uses short units: '120 ms' not '0.12 s' when median <1s. If mixed units exist, group series under unit headers with a thin divider.
Cam: Perf note: request bins and percentiles from backend. Client only renders canvas mini-sparks to avoid DOM bloat.
QA-Bot: Release checks: default outlier_mode = "fade", emit telemetry chart.unit_convert and chart.outlier_expand, ensure aria-live on scale change.
Zoe: I'll prototype in Storybook and send the PR. Pairing 11am tomorrow?
Hiro: I'll join. Cam: can you mock the backend payload shape?
Cam: Yup, will DM an example. Thanks all.
